claims.text: If you are thirty, on Saturn you would have just turned one.
A year there lasts about twenty-nine and a half of ours.
On Mercury, a year is just eighty-eight days.
You would be about a hundred and twenty-four.
On Mars, with its 687-day year, you would be about sixteen.
And on Neptune, one year lasts about a hundred and sixty-four of ours.
And on Neptune, one year lasts about a hundred and sixty-four of ours.
You would only celebrate your first birthday at a hundred and sixty-four.

A year is one trip around the Sun, and every planet takes a different time. At 30 Earth years you would be about 124 on Mercury, 16 on Mars and just 1 on Saturn, and you would only reach your first Neptune birthday at 164.
